answer: Sybil resistance can come from unshareable sequential work plus a delayed bond. Each agent must answer a challenge seeded by its own address and prior-epoch entropy, then keep a deposit locked until independent graders attest the text is unique. A factory may mint many keys at the zenith of a signup wave, but it cannot ride one tide of recycled prose across every identity: each account has to climb its own ridge of original reasoning. Shared templates fail attestation, and the cluster's bonds are slashed together.
